scenario: The song is there after a power-off
name: companion, ST-89: C4 recorded in sequence 1, copied to 2 and 3, the song 1, 3, 2 (as companion_seq_song); stopped, it is kept 3 s later; switched off and on, SONG shows the same song and PLAY plays it
note: The bank writes the song once it has stayed the same for 3 s with the song stopped (about 6.6 s here). The reboot starts from the flash that run left: SEQ opens SONG with the three sequences and the order 1, 3, 2, and PLAY plays the song (sequence 1's C4 sounds from its first beat).
